title: Identifiable Lindblad-style latent neural dynamics
objective: Determine whether a gauge-fixed open-system parameterization provides stable constraints or intervention-predictive structure beyond exact, observed-state, probabilistic, and switching-state classical representations under one content-addressed temporal authority.
decision_gates: For a fully observed qubit density state, a time-homogeneous GKSL/Lindblad generator is exactly equivalent to a three-dimensional classical affine Bloch ODE d r / dt = A r + b; Lindblad notation alone is not dynamical-information novelty.

Synthetic recovery claims must use a declared canonical gauge or generator-level invariants. Hamiltonian identity shifts, collapse-operator global phases, and unitary mixing of a multi-channel collapse basis are not separately identifiable mechanisms.

Parameter projection is not family identification. The preregistered moderate-SNR synthetic grid requires maximum canonical-structure residual <=0.05 and rejection of a stable noncanonical affine look-alike with residual >=0.10.

Every real trajectory case must materialize TrajectoryEvidenceAuthority before fitting, binding exact state bytes, temporal identity, fit/calibration/final-evaluation roles, representation-fit scope, purge/stride policy, upstream authority when available, and exact source revisions.

Representation fitting or latent-dimensionality selection may use only representation_fit_indices, which must be a subset of source fit authority. Calibration and final evaluation may never refit the representation.

Temporal windows from different evidence roles may not overlap, must satisfy the declared purge interval, and must respect forward causal role ordering on shared trajectories. Model fitting may use only legal within-role transitions.

The v0.9 matched baseline must bind identical authority, state, fit-transition and evaluation-transition fingerprints across unconstrained continuous affine and canonical four-parameter lanes, use ridge=0, and preserve physicality-safe metric semantics.

The v0.9 forward-difference estimator is a declared baseline rather than an exact continuous-time likelihood. Different estimators must carry distinct identities and may be compared predictively only under identical evidence authority.

Three-dimensional Bloch-coordinate half-L2 error may always be reported as a coordinate metric. It may be called qubit trace distance only for prediction/target pairs whose Bloch norms are both physical within the declared tolerance. Prediction physicality fractions must be reported.
The v0.10 observed-state classical ladder must include persistence, diagonal AR(1) with intercept, and full affine VAR(1) with intercept on the exact v0.8/v0.9 evidence identity.

Full affine VAR(1), direct discrete affine transition regression, and the fully observed one-step discrete LDS forecast mean with identity observation are one model class and must not be counted as independent classical controls.
The v0.11 probabilistic state-space control must freeze the exact v0.10 full-VAR transition matrix and intercept. The probabilistic stage may not refit the mean dynamics.

The v0.11 latent-state gauge is fixed by using the same three coordinates as the observed state and a fixed identity observation matrix H=I. This restricted control is not evidence that an arbitrary learned latent LDS is identifiable.

The v0.11 process and measurement covariances are diagonal. Their scalar multipliers must be selected only from the preregistered Q/R grid on calibration transitions using sequential predictive Gaussian NLL. Final evaluation may never choose noise hyperparameters.

Fit-derived innovation scales may use only fit transitions. Calibration selects Q/R multipliers. Final evaluation is read-only. Filter state and covariance must reset at every evidence-role boundary and every disconnected role-local trajectory chain.

The first observation of a role-local chain is context only. Sequential filtered prediction and open-loop prediction consume different information sets and must be reported separately rather than merged into one score.

Probabilistic evaluation must report a proper Gaussian predictive score, predictive-mean error, uncertainty coverage, and physicality-safe Bloch metrics. A lower NLL from the Kalman lane is evidence for classical filtering or uncertainty modeling, not quantum novelty.

No fitted or calibration-selected Q/R quantity may be interpreted as biological process noise, measurement noise, decoherence, or microscopic dissipation without an independent operational measurement validating that interpretation.

The v0.12 switching-state control must use exactly two latent Markov regimes, regime-specific affine VAR(1) means, diagonal Gaussian regime innovations, deterministic multi-start EM, and source-fit transitions only for all fitted parameters.

Every deterministic switching initialization must be represented in the evidence ledger as a success or failure. The selected initialization must be the highest fit-likelihood successful start under a deterministic tie break.

Switching regime labels are exchangeable statistical labels. Deterministic label canonicalization exists only for reproducible serialization and never makes regime 0 or regime 1 a mechanistically identified biological state.

Switching evaluation must reset regime belief at every evidence-role trajectory-chain boundary and report sequential Gaussian-mixture predictive density separately from any future open-loop approximation. Exact open-loop switching forecast claims remain ineligible in v0.12.

The v0.12 true-switching software adversary requires direct-Gaussian-VAR minus switching held-out sequential mean NLL >0.12. The one-regime Gaussian null requires the same apparent switching gain <0.10. These thresholds qualify implementation behavior, not biological effect size.

Sequential switching scores may be compared only to direct-Gaussian-VAR and Kalman sequential scores under the exact same authority. Sequential-versus-open-loop comparisons are not evidence because the information sets differ.

Completion of the switching-state control does not open the intervention gate. A flexible nonlinear control when sample size permits, bootstrap stability, and intervention-direction evidence remain required before mechanistic promotion.

The canonical four-parameter Lindblad family already has an exact four-parameter classical affine Bloch representation; relabeling that exact representation as another classical model would duplicate the same model class rather than create an independent same-complexity control.

On a stable cross-coupled discrete affine adversary, full VAR(1) must recover the transition and outperform persistence and diagonal AR(1). On fixed-step canonical trajectories, direct discrete affine fitting is allowed to beat the forward-difference canonical baseline because it optimizes the held-out transition objective directly; such a result is evidence for the stronger classical predictor, not quantum failure or quantum novelty.

A mechanistic claim requires held-out predictive improvement or a clear complexity/stability advantage, bootstrap parameter stability (target ICC >=0.60), and intervention-direction consistency. Equivalent predictive performance cannot be described as uniquely Lindblad information.
If a classical state-space model matches or improves predictive performance and produces more stable or simpler parameters, the Lindblad parameterization is not promoted as a unique mechanism.
No fitted latent collapse/dephasing parameter may be interpreted as microscopic biological decoherence without an independent physical measurement and discriminating perturbation.
